extractions.value: First pediatric case of PERM with GlyR antibodies. Patient had normal psychomotor development until onset at 14 months. Episodes occurred during wakefulness and sleep. Serum creatine phosphokinase and lactate dehydrogenase were elevated during relapse. GlyR antibody titer decreased to 1:60 after treatment. Genetic testing for glycine receptor mutations in SLC6A5, GLRA1, GLRB was negative.
